entities.summary: Nathan Roberts is an Australian volleyball player. He attended Brighton Secondary School from 1999 to 2003 and was a member of the school's Special Interest Volleyball program. He has played 395 matches for the Australian National Team including the 2006, 2010 & 2014 World Championships. He was a gold medalist at the 2007 Asian Championships in Jakarta, Indonesia and was the Best Spiker at the 2011 Asian Championships in Tehran, Iran. Nathan has also won the Australian Volleyball League Championship in 2003, Danish Volleyball League Championship in 2006, The Slovenian Cup and League Championships in 2015, and the French Pro B Championship.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Nathan Roberts' achievements in volleyball have contributed to Australia's national team success, including multiple World Championships and Asian Championship titles. His individual awards, such as Best Spiker at the 2011 Asian Championships, demonstrate his impact on the sport.
